main_body: Flat dark-green ground patch (moss/grass terrain) tiled in a repeating 4x3 pattern; no standing volume
top_band: none; a terrain tile with no top/front structure, so the 3/4 contract does not apply
evidence: The candidate is a flat ground texture of dark olive green with lighter and darker speckle clumps and a few orange and red-brown accent dots. It is not a standing object, so there is no top band or front face to read. The terrain kind makes the 3/4 object contract inapplicable, and the patch has no side faces or elevation drawing.

style.evidence: The ground patch has about 5 green steps (dark shadow, deep green, mid olive, light olive, pale highlight) arranged in clumps of speckle, with accent dots in orange and red-brown. No outlines are used, as is normal for a ground autotile. The texture is varied with no 5x5 flat areas, and each tile carries many colours, which matches or exceeds the grass reference. A weakness is the very regular repeat: the same clump motif recurs every 8 rows and 16 columns, with accent dots at identical offsets, giving a visible tiling pattern. That does not make it thinner than the reference, so it passes.
